items.summary: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) is back in focus after Meta folded its Muse AI shopping assistant into PayPal’s global merchant network, letting users move from product discovery to PayPal powered checkout inside the agent. items.title: Why Etsy (ETSY) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
